receipts.detail: readAuthoritativeRows returns a typed {state, rows} outcome distinguishing READABLE from UNAVAILABLE (never a bare-array collapse of missing/unavailable/failed to [])

an unavailable authority throws a typed deferred retryable error (deferRetry + retryAfterMs) so the join retries; zero upsertJoinNode calls (no fresh clobber over an authority that might hold the row)
